visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Inside a moving vehicle, a woman with long brown hair and a green crop top records a selfie video. She is expressive, touching her face and smiling. A man in a white hoodie is visible next to her. A small black plush toy sits in her lap. (2) Inside a bright hospital lobby, the man is shown filling out registration forms on a clipboard. The setting is clean with warm lighting and wooden accents. (3) The woman is in a clinical room; a nurse wearing blue gloves is drawing blood from her arm. The woman looks at the camera and smiles. (4) At a lab counter, the man is seen spitting into a collection tube while sitting behind a glass partition. The background shows clinical signage. (5) In an examination room, the woman lies on a bed for an ultrasound. An ultrasound machine and monitor displaying black and white medical imagery are clearly visible. (6) Inside a doctor's office, a male doctor wearing a mask, glasses, and a white coat points at data in a large book. The woman and her partner listen as they review the reports together. (7) The duo sits in a modern hospital lobby area, facing the camera for a final discussion. The background features glass-enclosed display cases with decorative items.

[Variety]: 30年經驗歐洲基因檢測專家. (5) [Subtitle]: 它可以測市面上最多的遺傳疾病. [Variety]: 2200種!!. (6) [Subtitle]: 全方位高CP值守護寶寶健康. (7) [Subtitle]: 老謝好少喔. (8) [Subtitle]: 欸這不能錄啦這18禁. (9) [Subtitle]: 沒有啊那個是唾液??. (26) [Subtitle]: 精子數量是夠的活動力比較差. [Variety]: 精子報告. (27) [Subtitle]: 軍容盛大很多兵馬對不對. (28) [Subtitle]: 但是每個兵都不太想動. (29) [Subtitle]: 結果是剛好勉強及格啦. (30) [Subtitle]: 不是保險套太好用是我的問題. (31) [Subtitle]: 還有我的精子跟我本人是一模一樣的. (32) [Subtitle]: 懶散懶散白白的嘛.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a couple's journey undergoing comprehensive genetic and fertility testing (CGT, AMH, and sperm quality) at a professional hospital to provide educational insight and personal experience regarding family planning.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Frequent display of the hospital's name (茂盛醫院) and positive testimonials regarding their testing technology and staff expertise.
